name: Pumpkin Pie Pudding Cups with Whipped Cream & Pecans

instructions.primary_message: Place a medium bowl (preferably metal) in the freezer to chill. (If space is limited, place in the refrigerator.)

Using a box grater, coarsely grate cream cheese into another medium bowl; add cinnamon and nutmeg. Use a silicone spatula or fork to soften and combine the cream cheese mixture, creating a smooth cream.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (227 g) blocks cream cheese
¾ tsp cinnamon
3 pinch nutmeg, ground

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer, sift powdered sugar into the bowl with the cream cheese. Use the spatula or fork to mash and combine the mixture until smooth and no lumps remain.
Add pumpkin to the cream cheese mixture and fold to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (398 ml) cans pure pumpkin purée

instructions.primary_message: Remove bowl from the freezer. Pour cold cream into the bowl.

Add sugar and vanilla to the bowl with the cream; use a whisk (or hand blender) to beat the cream vigorously, until medium-soft peaks form, about 4 minutes if whisking. (When you pull the whisk out of the bowl, the cream should hold its shape, with a peak that curls over slightly.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp powdered sugar
¾ tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Transfer half the whipped cream to the bowl with the pumpkin mixture (reserve remaining whipped cream for garnish). Using a silicone spatula, gently fold the two together to combine the pudding.
Divide pudding between glasses. Top with remaining whipped cream, pecans, and cinnamon. Enjoy!
